safari.title: Push notifications
safari.description: Get critical alerts (incidents, assigned tickets, mentions) directly on this device.
safari.enableSuccess: Push notifications enabled on this device
safari.enableError: Could not enable notifications. Check the browser's permission settings.
safari.disableSuccess: Push notifications disabled on this device
safari.denied: Notifications are blocked in browser settings. Re-enable them for this device to activate this option.
safari.unsupported: This browser does not support push notifications.
safari.iosInstallDescription: On iOS, Apple requires the intranet to be added to the Home Screen before push notifications can be enabled. This is a one-time setup per device.
safari.iosStep1: Tap the Share icon in the Safari toolbar.
safari.iosStep2: Choose "Add to Home Screen" from the list.
safari.iosStep3: Reopen the intranet from the installed icon, then come back here to enable notifications.
safari.iosScreenshotPlaceholder: Screenshot coming soon: Share icon → Add to Home Screen
safari.iosNote: Requires iOS 16.4 or later (iPhone and iPad).
safari.iosInstalledHint: PWA installed on Home Screen — you can now enable notifications.
safari.serverNotReady: The server does not seem to be configured for Safari notifications. Contact your administrator.
